summary.en: Kogoro is invited with Ran and Conan to an aquarium where an underwater play is to take place. They meet the man named Masato Hayashi who is a stage director. Next to him is the woman who plays as Venus named Michiko Oosawa. When Hayashi gives a tour around the aquarium, they meet two other people. There's Yasuyuki Murakawa, the head of staff. Finally, there's Yuriko Minegishi, she counts as another Venus in the group. Later during the show, Oosawa's dead body rises from the water when it's her cue to come out of a clam's shell in the play. Location: Beika Street Aquarium Victim: Michiko Oosawa Cause of death: Drowning Suspects: Masato Hayashi, Yasuyuki Murakawa, and Yuriko Minegishi During the show, Oosawa's dead body rises from the clam in front of a horrified audience.
